name: LUMOS (Zhejiang University)
what: 803 living patients: 1,620 lumbar AP or lateral radiographs and 280 non-contrast lumbar CTs, anonymised DICOM and NPY; diagnostic radiography, not C-arm fluoroscopy; no pose given
level_truth: levels readable from the paired CT after a 2D/3D registration
status: held on the grid since 2026-10-23 (spine-datasets' record: /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/zenodo_lumos, 77 GB); diagnostic radiographs, not C-arm, whose levels come only through a registration to the paired CT
